contexts.text: When the days were completed for the putting off of the human...
These are the days completed for the putting off of the old man...
In the third day = what is complete, and the beginning of sanctification.
Three = what is complete, and a beginning... Seven, and seventy, have a similar signification.
The third day = what is complete, thus the end.
The third day = what is complete from beginning to end. AC 4495:end. (See further references see Three.)
The Word would not be complete...
Until their fellow-servants should be fulfilled () = till those should be collected from all quarters...
In every complete thing there is a trine... Coro 17:end.
